content:
Below is a namespaced composite API, `VersionedApplicationInfrastructure`, and a pipeline-mode Composition using `function-patch-and-transform`.

It creates:

- Private S3 bucket with versioning and AES-256 encryption
- PostgreSQL RDS instance with deletion protection, backups, encryption, and no public access
- IRSA IAM role with an OIDC trust policy and least-privilege access to only the application bucket

The database password is referenced from an existing Kubernetes Secret and is never embedded in the manifests.

### 1. Function installation

```yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.8.2
```

### 2. XRD

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: versionedapplicationinfrastructures.platform.example.io
spec:
  group: platform.example.io
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    kind: VersionedApplicationInfrastructure
    plural: versionedapplicationinfrastructures
    singular: versionedapplicationinfrastructure
    shortNames:
      - vai
  claimNames:
    kind: ApplicationInfrastructure
    plural: applicationinfrastructures
    singular: applicationinfrastructure
  defaultCompositionRef:
    name: versioned-application-infrastructure-aws
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - spec
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              required:
                - parameters
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  required:
                    - environment
                    - region
                    - providerConfigName
                    - bucketName
                    - database
                    - irsa
                  properties:
                    environment:
                      type: string
                      enum:
                        - dev
                        - prod

                    region:
                      type: string
                      description: AWS region in which resources are created.

                    providerConfigName:
                      type: string
                      description: Crossplane AWS ProviderConfig name.

                    bucketName:
                      type: string
                      description: Globally unique S3 bucket name.
                      minLength: 3
                      maxLength: 63

                    database:
                      type: object
                      required:
                        - identifier
                        - instanceClass
                        - multiAZ
                        - allocatedStorageGB
                        - username
                        - passwordSecretRef
                      properties:
                        identifier:
                          type: string
                        instanceClass:
                          type: string
                          enum:
                            - db.t3.micro
                            - db.t3.medium
                        multiAZ:
                          type: boolean
                        allocatedStorageGB:
                          type: integer
                          minimum: 20
                        username:
                          type: string
                        databaseName:
                          type: string
                          default: app
                        subnetGroupName:
                          type: string
                          description: Existing RDS DB subnet group.
                        securityGroupIds:
                          type: array
                          items:
                            type: string
                        passwordSecretRef:
                          type: object
                          required:
                            - name
                            - key
                          properties:
                            name:
                              type: string
                            namespace:
                              type: string
                              description: Defaults to the composite namespace.
                            key:
                              type: string

                    irsa:
                      type: object
                      required:
                        - roleName
                        - oidcProviderArn
                        - oidcIssuerHostPath
                        - namespace
                        - serviceAccountName
                      properties:
                        roleName:
                          type: string
                        oidcProviderArn:
                          type: string
                          description: ARN of the EKS OIDC provider.
                        oidcIssuerHostPath:
                          type: string
                          description: >-
                            OIDC issuer without the https:// prefix, for example
                            oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE.
                        namespace:
                          type: string
                        serviceAccountName:
                          type: string

            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketArn:
                  type: string
                bucketRegion:
                  type: string
                databaseAddress:
                  type: string
                databasePort:
                  type: integer
                iamRoleArn:
                  type: string
```

### 3. Composition

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: versioned-application-infrastructure-aws
  labels:
    provider: aws
    platform.example.io/type: application-infrastructure
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
    kind: VersionedApplicationInfrastructure

  mode: Pipeline

  pipeline:
    - step: create-aws-resources
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          # -------------------------------------------------------------------
          # S3 bucket
          # -------------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Bucket
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  forceDestroy: false
                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.bucketArn
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.region
                toFieldPath: status.bucketRegion
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          - name: bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
                      bucketKeyEnabled: true
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          - name: bucket-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          # -------------------------------------------------------------------
          # RDS PostgreSQL
          # -------------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: database
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Instance
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Orphan
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  engine: postgres
                  instanceClass: db.t3.micro
                  allocatedStorage: 20
                  storageType: gp3
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  multiAZ: false
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  deletionProtection: true
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  autoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
                  copyTagsToSnapshot: true
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  finalSnapshotIdentifier: placeholder-final-snapshot
                  username: appadmin
                  passwordSecretRef:
                    name: placeholder-db-password
                    namespace: default
                    key: password
                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.identifier
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.identifier

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.identifier
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.finalSnapshotIdentifier
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      type: Format
                      fmt: "%s-final"

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.instanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.multiAZ
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAZ

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.allocatedStorageGB
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.username
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.databaseName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.subnetGroupName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbSubnetGroupName
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.securityGroupIds
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.vpcSecurityGroupIds
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.passwordSecretRef.name
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.passwordSecretRef.namespace
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.namespace
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.namespace
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.namespace

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.passwordSecretRef.namespace
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.namespace
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.passwordSecretRef.key
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.key

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address
                toFieldPath: status.databaseAddress
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.port
                toFieldPath: status.databasePort
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

          # -------------------------------------------------------------------
          # IAM role for Kubernetes service accounts (IRSA)
          # -------------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: service-account-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  assumeRolePolicy: "{}"
                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.irsa.roleName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment

              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  strategy: string
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.irsa.oidcProviderArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.irsa.oidcIssuerHostPath
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.irsa.namespace
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.irsa.serviceAccountName
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.irsa.oidcIssuerHostPath
                  string:
                    fmt: >-
                      {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Federated":"%s"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"%s:sub":"system:serviceaccount:%s:%s","%s:aud":"sts.amazonaws.com"}}}]}
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.iamRoleArn
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

          # Exact-bucket permissions; no wildcard actions.
          - name: service-account-bucket-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  roleSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  policy: "{}"
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.irsa.roleName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      type: Format
                      fmt: "%s-application-assets"

              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  strategy: string
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                  string:
                    fmt: >-
                      {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"ListApplicationBucket","Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketLocation"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::%s"},{"Sid":"ManageApplicationObjects","Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:GetObjectVersion","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"}]}
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
```

### 4. Example encrypted password Secret

The actual password should be supplied by an external secret system, SOPS, Sealed Secrets, or a Crossplane secret store. Do not commit a normal plaintext `Secret`.

For example, the resulting runtime Secret should have this shape:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: app-db-password
  namespace: app-dev
type: Opaque
stringData:
  password: REPLACED_BY_SOPS_OR_EXTERNAL_SECRET
```

### 5. Dev claim

```yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
kind: ApplicationInfrastructure
metadata:
  name: app-dev
  namespace: app-dev
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: dev
    region: us-east-1
    providerConfigName: aws-dev

    bucketName: example-app-assets-dev

    database:
      identifier: example-app-dev
      instanceClass: db.t3.micro
      multiAZ: false
      allocatedStorageGB: 20
      username: appadmin
      databaseName: app
      subnetGroupName: app-dev
      securityGroupIds:
        - sg-0123456789abcdef0
      passwordSecretRef:
        name: app-db-password
        namespace: app-dev
        key: password

    irsa:
      roleName: example-app-dev
      oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVEXAMPLE
      oidcIssuerHostPath: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVEXAMPLE
      namespace: app-dev
      serviceAccountName: web
```

### 6. Prod claim

```yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
kind: ApplicationInfrastructure
metadata:
  name: app-prod
  namespace: app-prod
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: prod
    region: us-east-1
    providerConfigName: aws-prod

    bucketName: example-app-assets-prod

    database:
      identifier: example-app-prod
      instanceClass: db.t3.medium
      multiAZ: true
      allocatedStorageGB: 100
      username: appadmin
      databaseName: app
      subnetGroupName: app-prod
      securityGroupIds:
        - sg-0fedcba9876543210
      passwordSecretRef:
        name: app-db-password
        namespace: app-prod
        key: password

    irsa:
      roleName: example-app-prod
      oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::222222222222:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODEXAMPLE
      oidcIssuerHostPath: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODEXAMPLE
      namespace: app-prod
      serviceAccountName: web
```

Use separate `aws-dev` and `aws-prod` ProviderConfigs, ideally backed by separate AWS accounts or credentials, to keep the environments independently deployable. This implementation covers the three resources requested; EKS, HTTPS/CloudFront, ACM, and production S3 cross-region replication would require additional composed resources.
